name: Cenarion Circle
summary: Across Azeroth, the Cenarion Circle guards nature’s balance. Founded by Malfurion Stormrage under Cenarius, it keeps its sacred haven in Moonglade and tends the Emerald Dream and blighted lands. Once made up of night elves, it now welcomes tauren druids to defend the living world.

sections.title: Origins of the Circle
sections.body: Thousands of years ago, Cenarius taught Malfurion Stormrage, the first mortal druid. After the Great Sundering, Malfurion gathered those who wished to learn nature’s ways. The order made its home in Moonglade’s sacred vale. Ever since, the Circle has watched over Azeroth’s wild places.

sections.title: A Sacred Neutrality
sections.body:
The Cenarion Circle is rooted in night elf history, yet answers neither to Darnassus nor to the Sisterhood of Elune. Its heart is Moonglade, where the peaceful town of Nighthaven keeps an ancient truce. Weapons stay sheathed there, beyond the reach of mortal wars.

After the Third War, Malfurion and Hamuul Runetotem, a tauren elder, became friends and came to respect one another. The Circle honored the tauren’s reverence for the Earth Mother and welcomed Hamuul into its ranks. Through him, druidism returned to his people after thousands of years.

sections.title: Tension and the Absent Archdruid
sections.body:
After the devastation at Mount Hyjal, Malfurion fell into an unnatural, impenetrable coma in his barrow den. With no leader, the druids left Archdruid Fandral Staghelm in practical command of the Circle. Fandral used Malfurion’s silence to rally support for growing Teldrassil, hoping to restore the kaldorei’s lost immortality.

The Dragon Aspects refused to bless the tree, and strange corruption has taken root in its branches. Division stirs within the order as Fandral rules with a stern hand. Ancient guardians sense darkness spreading from Silithus and the Emerald Dream.

faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is an ancient order of druids devoted to nature’s balance, the wild, and the Emerald Dream. Malfurion Stormrage founded it under Cenarius’s guidance, and its sanctuary lies in Moonglade.

faq.q: Where is the headquarters of the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle is based in Moonglade, around Nighthaven and the shores of Lake Elune'ara. Its outposts and barrow dens reach across Kalimdor, including Cenarion Hold in Silithus, where the order keeps watch.

faq.q: Why are tauren in the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem joined the Cenarion Circle after he and Malfurion Stormrage fought together at Mount Hyjal during the Third War. They came to respect one another, and Malfurion shared druidic teachings with Hamuul. Hamuul became the first tauren druid in millennia, bringing tauren and night elf druids into partnership.

Malfurion Stormrage led the Cenarion Circle with elder archdruids. While Malfurion lies in an unexplained coma in his barrow, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm leads in practice from Darnassus. Hamuul Runetotem and the keepers in Moonglade guide their own factions.

faq.q: Is the Cenarion Circle part of the Alliance?
faq.answer: No. The Cenarion Circle is neutral, and its members swear themselves to nature rather than mortal rulers. Alliance and Horde druids walk side by side in Moonglade and other Cenarion encampments.

faq.q: What happened at the Scarab Wall in Silithus?
faq.answer: During the War of the Shifting Sands a thousand years ago, Archdruid Fandral Staghelm led the night elves and the Cenarion Circle against the qiraji swarm, aided by the dragonflights. The bronze dragon Anachronos and his allies raised the Scarab Wall to seal away the hive. The Circle built Cenarion Hold to watch over the seal.

angles.text: As a druid, you belong to the Cenarion Circle, your spiritual authority. Whether your tutelage comes from Darnassus or the plains of Mulgore, the Circle’s rites in Moonglade guide your power, trials, and callings.

For ten thousand years, your people’s men chiefly slept in barrows in service to the Cenarion Circle while Sentinels guarded your borders. The Circle’s bond with the wild shaped every part of kaldorei culture.
Through Hamuul Runetotem’s friendship with Malfurion Stormrage, your people reclaimed ancient traditions tied to the Earth Mother and earned an honored place in the Cenarion Circle.
The Cenarion Circle’s druids understand Azeroth’s plant life and the delicate ecosystems that sustain rare and magical flora.
